mapper.sql: sys12_calendar_id AS calendar_id, sys12_company_id AS company_id, TO_CHAR(sys12_day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, sys12_weekday AS weekday, sys12_working_yn AS working_yn, sys12_off_reason AS off_reason, sys12_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT , sys01_company_nm AS company_name FROM sys12_calendar INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = sys12_company_id WHERE 1=1 AND sys12_company_id != 0 AND sys12_day = #{day}::timestamp AND sys01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY sys01_company_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys12_calendar (sys12_calendar_id, sys12_company_id, sys12_day, sys12_weekday, sys12_working_yn, sys12_off_reason, sys12_note) SELECT seq , company_id , dt , CASE to_char(dt, 'D') WHEN '1' THEN '일요일' WHEN '2' THEN '월요일' WHEN '3' THEN '화요일' WHEN '4' THEN '수요일' WHEN '5' THEN '목요일' WHEN '6' THEN '금요일' WHEN '7' THEN '토요일' END AS yoil , CASE to_char(dt, 'D') WHEN '1' THEN 'false' WHEN '7' THEN 'false' ELSE ( CASE WHEN sys14_holiday_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'false' ELSE 'true' END ) END AS working_yn , sys14_holiday_nm AS sys12_off_reason , '' FROM ( SELECT f_create_seq() AS seq , #{companyId}::numeric AS company_id , generate_series(to_date(#{startYmd},'yyyymmdd'), to_date(#{endYmd},'yyyymmdd'), '1 day'::interval)::date AS dt ) a LEFT OUTER JOIN sys14_holiday ON ( sys14_company_id = company_id AND sys14_day = dt )
